title: Something for the Weekend
content:
Track of the Week

Lnrdcroy – ‘Telegraph of Love’

Lnrdcroy’s first album Much Less Normal was released on cassette last year and is now getting re-released on vinyl. My favourite track is ‘Telegraphy my Love’. The whole album is fantastic! It is a very accessible album, it flows naturally, and as Andrew Ryce puts it, “the rhythms arranged with a plainness that makes them feel as natural as getting up in the morning and sipping a cup of coffee. ” 

Best Track You’ve Never Heard

Claudia – ‘Com Maid de 30’

Short and sweet! Some latin vibes for a the January blues.
